packets.title: Strong emergence
packets.scope: One developed irreducible-emergent consciousness account, strongest causal/explanatory challenge, and direct reply where available; distinguish emergence from physical identity and fundamental experience.

packets.title: Substance dualism
packets.scope: One developed subject/interaction/persistence account, causal or epistemic challenge and reply; do not infer observed survival from a bearer theory.

packets.title: Panpsychism and constitution
packets.scope: Selected original experiential-constitution defense, combination challenge and reply; recover exact missing Strawson text/version if relevant.

packets.title: Universal and plural idealism
packets.scope: One explicit universal-ground account and one contrasting plural-ground account, with selected direct critique/reply; check manuscript versions and cited illustration limits.

packets.title: Illusionism
packets.scope: One developed original illusionist account, direct strongest phenomenal-target objection and reply; distinguish denying phenomenal properties as conceived from denying reports or all conscious functions.

packets.title: Moral constructivism and rational grounding
packets.scope: One developed positive constructivist/rational account, direct objection and reply; distinguish obligation, value and categorical reasons.

packets.title: Non-natural moral realism
packets.scope: One developed positive non-natural realist account, direct objection and reply; compare exact Craig/Railton claims and identify unclosed reply branches.

packets.title: Theodicy and hiddenness replies
packets.scope: Select the defense most relevant to the v1 restoration/perfect-love argument; original defense, serious objection and reply. Screen other free-will/soul-making/skeptical-theism branches explicitly; no complete-theodicy claim.

packets.title: AWARE and Dutch versions and replies
packets.scope: Named AWARE II author reply, relevant main-paper/supplement/flow versions and Dutch correction; opportunity intersections and numerical/inferential effects. Reynolds replies belong to P2T16.

packets.title: Sufficient reason and necessary foundation
packets.scope: One modern defended PSR/necessary-ground argument, direct critic and reply, with selected Lennox relevance; retain distinct foundation-to-mind bridge.

packets.title: Fine-tuning and intention
packets.scope: One exact positive fine-tuning argument/version plus direct selection/probability critique and reply; separate mathematical assumptions from verified physical measures or designer preferences.

packets.title: Timeless ground and personal identity
packets.scope: One specified timeless-ground/temporal-persons model and identity objection/reply exchange; exact modern versions. Screen remaining time/identity/physics branches without whole-literature closure.

packets.title: Endurance and meaning
packets.scope: Exact versions of the selected endurance/meaning argument and strongest necessity/enhancement objection/reply; prioritize Metz2000/Wolf/Fischer edition gaps as relevant. Williams already supplied and reviewed.

packets.title: Neal public earliest documentation
packets.scope: One case: earliest accessible memoir/disclosure, dated prediction records, public rescue chronology and direct case critic/reply; audio-authentication limits separate. No private-record demand.

packets.title: Alexander public earliest documentation
packets.scope: One case: AANS/full memoir appendix and earliest disclosures plus selected direct critique/reply; distinguish publicly documented timing from inaccessible charts/audio.

packets.title: Reynolds earliest documents and later replies
packets.scope: One case: Sabom chapter/earliest account and later Woerlee rejoinder/Smit hearing-test letter; owns Reynolds reply chain, timing and technical-version comparison.

packets.title: Dentures and TG public originals
packets.scope: One case: earliest 1991/1994 and Dutch TG2008 public texts or translations, witness-chain comparison and chronology; no inferred cohort membership or invented patient testimony.

packets.title: Selected empirical breadth and dependence
packets.scope: One prespecified underrepresented historical/cultural corpus with translation check plus one early/null prospective original and selected direct criticism. Audit overlap/response wording in relevant comparisons. All other strata remain explicitly unassessed.

packets.title: Neural protocols and replies
packets.scope: One relevant protocol/amendment and direct theory-reply chain plus targeted missing denominators from existing intervention packets; no full code reanalysis or whole-theory winner.
